meta.title: UI actions
meta.description: Shared buttons for plugin pages (ask, done, snooze, open) and items attached to a chat as a card.

ui.pending: Waiting for it to be picked up
ui.noWorkspace: Open a conversation once first, then try again.
ui.noSession: That conversation didn’t open. Try again from the conversation list.
ui.busy: The message box is busy sending; try again in a moment.
ui.noHandler: This button has nothing to send its press to.
